ptax.name: IL Dept of Revenue PTAX-203 transfer declarations (industrial use)

permits.name: Cook County Assessor building permits (non-residential, >= $50k, last 3 yrs)

tdel.name: Cook County Clerk 20-year delinquent property tax file

fmcsa.name: FMCSA active motor carrier census (3+ power units)

warn.name: Illinois WARN notices (IL Dept of Commerce, monthly reports)

chi_permits.name: City of Chicago building permits (>= $50k reported cost, plus all wrecking/demolition), last 3 yrs

cook_val.name: Cook County Assessor commercial valuation, industrial (assessor's assumed rent, vacancy, cap rate; estimates, not leases)

proximity.name: Cook County Assessor parcel proximity (nearest rail line, highway and its daily traffic)

appeals.name: Cook County Assessor appeals (industrial/commercial classes, last 3 yrs)

flood.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (Special Flood Hazard Areas, simplified ~5 m), parcel center point
